svg.title: The transformer copies values from the census prompt
svg.desc: Cost map of the transformer alone on census page 194,559 of the coder stream (Yardley, Pennsylvania). Top, the rows fed in front of the page and behind its title, the context row, the page rows and the block with the census values. Below, five excerpts of the page as coded bytes, each once with the prompt rows and once without them, every unit shaded by its cost in bits per byte; spans that also stand in the census prompt are underlined. At the bottom, the cost of the page and of 958 census pages whose stubs keep 3 or more phrases of the template, in both arms.
svg.text: The transformer copies values from the census prompt
Census page 194,559 of the coder stream (Yardley, Pennsylvania). The transformer of this entry alone, once with its prompt rows and once without them.
Prompt rows of the page (fed to the transformer, not coded)
in front of the title: context row (kind of place, state) and page rows (page index, population and area, contributor, day)
behind the title: census values block (values of the record in sentences of the template wording)
As of the 2000 census, the borough had a total population of 2,498, with 1,170 households, 649 families and 1,209
housing units. The borough has a total area of 2.6 km² (1.0 mi²): 2.4 km² (0.9 mi²) of it is land and 0.3 km² (0.1
mi²) of it is water, 9.90% water. The population density is 1,048.4/km² (2,729.0/mi²). Yardley is located at 40°14'29"
North, 74°50'11" West (40.241508, -74.836325). The median income for a household is $58,221, for a family $70,938, and
Excerpts of the page in stream order, cost of each unit in bits per byte of the coder stream
Title and first line of the page
Sentences in the template wording that stay in the stub, values not in the prompt
Sentences in the template wording that stay in the stub, values in the prompt

of these, digits that stand in the census prompt (6,012 bytes)
of these, digits that stand in no prompt row (145,890 bytes)
Without prompt: the same rows of the page without any fed row (the context row, the page rows, the census values block and
the link context). Both arms get the PPMd input and the match channel of the coder. A dictionary word is one to three bytes.
¶ marks a line feed and ² the three bytes of an escaped character.
